name: medqa_s80_v1_r2_strict_early
responses: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

My main symptom is Swelling of the right knee. I also have No recent trauma or injury, Familial history of similar symptoms. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Tuberculosis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.
Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: The parents report no known allergies, normal birth and developmental history for the child.
Denies fever, rash, or recent illnesses.
